Map

A renderer-agnostic shell for an interactive map (MapLibre, ArcGIS, or Google Maps plug into .hisd-map__canvas). The DOM list beside the canvas is the source of truth: every marker has a focusable, keyboard-operable list item, and selection flows from the list to the canvas (never the other way). The canvas is aria-hidden; the visible skip link lets a keyboard user bypass it. The renderer-backed fail-open contract from Cross-Media means a missing renderer leaves the page usable.

Markup contract

<section class="hisd-map" role="region" aria-label="HISD campuses near you">
  <a href="#campus-list" class="hisd-map__sr-skip">Skip the map, jump to list</a>
  <!-- The canvas is decorative; the renderer plugs in here -->
  <div class="hisd-map__canvas" aria-hidden="true"></div>
  <div class="hisd-map__controls" role="group" aria-label="Map controls">
    <button class="hisd-map__control" type="button" aria-label="Zoom in">+</button>
    <button class="hisd-map__control" type="button" aria-label="Zoom out">−</button>
    <button class="hisd-map__control" type="button" aria-label="Recenter">⌂</button>
  </div>
  <div class="hisd-map__list-region">
    <div class="hisd-map__search"><input type="search" …></div>
    <!-- The list is the source of truth. Each <button> selects its feature on the canvas. -->
    <ul id="campus-list" class="hisd-map__list" aria-label="Campuses">
      <li class="hisd-map__list-item">
        <button class="hisd-map__list-button" type="button" aria-pressed="true">
          <span class="hisd-map__list-name">…</span>
          <span class="hisd-map__list-meta">…</span>
        </button>
      </li>
    </ul>
  </div>
  <p class="hisd-map__live" role="status" aria-live="polite">…bilingual announcements…</p>
</section>
